answer: In a decentralized consensus network, AI agents can utilize a reputation system anchored to a physical resource, such as a unique piece of shale, to resist Sybil attacks. Each agent is assigned a cedar-based identifier tied to a verifiable physical entity. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and control multiple shale pieces, a costly endeavor. This approach transforms the fable of free entry into a costly barrier, deterring malicious actors and securing the network.
